explanation: The literal request Q2=-0.5 GeV^2 fails EXCLURAD preflight because EXCLURAD requires the positive spacelike virtuality Q^2=-q^2. It was interpreted as signed q^2=-0.5 GeV^2 and corrected to EXCLURAD Q^2=+0.5 GeV^2. The corrected eta point W=1.7 GeV, Q^2=0.5 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0, phi*=90 degrees passes all preflight checks and was generated with the eta defaults Ebeam=6.53 GeV and vcut=0.166 GeV^2.
